title: Three Mondays and One Short Bell
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：lesson　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lesson 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the teacher ① learnt the lesson that no pupil in the schoolroom would have recorded, and he said the learning was the whole of the Monday. The ② lesson, meaning the class itself and not the bell, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lesson, he said, is the only thing in a schoolroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lesson in that schoolroom had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ lesson at the far window, meaning the line they kept for the children to learn by heart and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lesson, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the teacher said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lesson was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the class. The ⑥ lesson, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lesson, he said, is either something you learn or the only word that means both a class and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ lesson had become a line in a copybook, and the copybook had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ lesson of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in April, was one schoolroom and three Mondays of recording; lesson, he said, is either the line at the far window or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lesson I remember is the class recorded in the copybook, which closed in 1965 and is still recorded as the quietest in the schoolroom. A ⑩ lesson, my mother said in 1967, is the only class that improves by being recorded; every lesson, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like a class. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 课；教训（指学堂里每一堂旁边的那一堂）
B. n. 课；教训（指那堂课本身，与铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：learn the lesson 上这一堂课
D. n. 课；教训（指留给孩子们背下的那一行那一堂）
E. n. 为学之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的课之事）
F. n. 课；教训（指习字簿里写到、被记载的的那一堂）
G. n. 道理、见识（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 见识（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

the lesson at the far window

answers.why: learn the lesson 意为“上这一堂课”，1958 年那位先生把学堂里没有一位学童肯记载的一堂课做了一遍。
lesson 意为“课；教训”，指那堂课本身而不是铃，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
lesson 意为“课；教训”，指学堂里每一堂旁边的那一堂，每一堂旁边都有同一只小小的铃。
lesson 意为“课；教训”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们背下的那一行那一堂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lesson 意为“道理、见识”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个道理就是那件事的全部。
lesson 意为“见识”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那堂课，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lesson 意为“课；教训”，指习字簿里写到、被记载的的那一堂，到 1963 年这一堂成了习字簿里的一行。
lesson 意为“为学之事”，先生四月写道，整件事的课之事是一处学堂和三个星期一的记载。
lesson 意为“课；教训”，我记得的是习字簿里记载过的那一堂，1965 年上完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一堂。
lesson 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，课是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的课。
